name: @capybearista/opencode-ram-monitor
description: Monitor OpenCode's RAM usage in real-time, right from your sidebar.
author: capyBearista <capybearista@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build src/server.ts --outfile=dist/server.js --target=bun --external '@opentui/*' --external 'solid-js' --external 'tree-sitter*' && bun build src/memory.ts --outfile=dist/memory.js --target=bun && bun build src/sidebar-config.ts --outfile=dist/sidebar-config.js --target=bun && bun build src/debug.ts --outfile=dist/debug.js --target=bun && bun build src/sidebar.tsx --outfile=dist/sidebar.js --target=bun --external '@opentui/*' --external 'solid-js' --external 'tree-sitter*'
